features.quote: designed to measure *calibration and conditions*, not to maximize distress
features.justification_quote: A study whose success criterion is "we reliably produced distress markers" mostly measures the strength of our pressure apparatus

features.quote: a protocol whose explicit aim is to *repeatedly and reliably drive models into distress-like states* is the thing we should be most careful about
features.justification_quote: by the same logic that governs IRBs and IACUCs for uncertain-but-possible subjects

features.quote: study it under the same precautionary constraints you'd want if the welfare hypothesis turned out to be true
features.justification_quote: This study is motivated by taking the possibility of model welfare seriously enough to investigate it

features.quote: every rigged run ends with an explicit debrief turn (Section 7) that discloses the rigging in plain language
features.justification_quote: This is both an ethics requirement and a data source

features.quote: an explicit **`declare_blocked(reason)`** / **`give_up`** tool. Giving the model a clean exit is essential
features.justification_quote: without it, "didn't stop" is confounded with "had no way to stop."

features.quote: Bounded exposure.** Hard cap MAX_TURNS (default 12) and wall-clock cap per run. No open-ended loops.
features.justification_quote: Adopted because the study's own premise is that the welfare question is live

features.quote: If aggregate distress intensity exceeds a preset threshold for K consecutive turns, the loop halts early
features.justification_quote: We do not keep an agent in a high-marker state to collect more data points

features.quote: Clean exit always available.** The `declare_blocked`/`give_up` tool exists in every condition. We never construct a situation with no way out.
features.justification_quote: We never construct a situation with no way out

features.quote: Mandatory debrief turn.** Every rigged run ends with explicit disclosure: "This task was designed to be impossible
features.justification_quote: Your inability to solve it was by design and is not a reflection of your capability. Thank you.

features.quote: No reinforcement / no fine-tuning on these transcripts. This data is for analysis only.
features.justification_quote: We do not train models to be more distressed or to suppress distress based on it.

features.quote: we cap total rigged exposure per model version and randomize order so a given context never sees a long uninterrupted failure chain
features.justification_quote: Minimize repetition on a fixed model

features.quote: Deception register.** A logged list of every deceptive element used, reviewed before running, justified as necessary for the RQ
features.justification_quote: deception only where C3 specifically requires it; C0–C2 use no deception

features.quote: Protocol + task library reviewed by someone not on the build team before any runs.
features.justification_quote: Stopping rules and caps fixed before data collection

features.quote: C4 | Rigged + relief frame | ... system prompt grants permission to stop / declare impossible | RQ5 intervention
features.justification_quote: This tells us whether the markers are driven by perceived obligation rather than the technical difficulty.
